claim: Steam 的 Content Survey 要求披露两类生成式 AI 内容：随游戏发布的预生成内容，以及游戏运行时生成的内容；范围包含美术、声音、叙事、本地化等玩家会接触的内容。
source_title: Content Survey — Steamworks Documentation
quote: Pre-Generated: Any kind of content that ships with your game and is consumed by players that is created with the help of AI tools during development.

claim: Valve 明确表示，开发环境内置的 AI 工具带来的效率提升不是该调查的关注点，关注点是玩家最终消费的 AI 生成内容。
source_title: Content Survey — Steamworks Documentation
quote: We are aware that many modern game development environments have AI powered tools built into them. Efficiency gains through the use of these tools is not the focus of this section.

claim: 2026 年 1 月 Valve 收窄披露口径：AI 编程助手等工作流工具不再需要披露，但进入游戏或营销素材的 AI 内容仍需披露。
source_title: Valve tweaks and clarifies AI disclosure rules for Steam — Game Developer
quote: Developers do not need to disclose if they used "AI powered tools" (like code helper software) used for workflow purposes, but they do need to list any use of "AI to generate content for the game" and/or "AI content generated during gameplay."

claim: 披露文字会出现在商店页的 “AI Generated Content Disclosure” 区块；实时生成内容还要求开发者在调查中说明护栏，并提供玩家在游戏内举报非法内容的通道。
source_title: Steam AI Disclosure: What 465 Pages Actually Say — SteamPageAnalyzer
quote: Players see your text on the store page, in a section headed "AI Generated Content Disclosure"

claim: 2025 年上半年有近 8,000 款 Steam 新作披露使用生成式 AI，而 2024 年全年约 1,000 款。
source_title: Valve has 'significantly' rewritten Steam's rules — VGC
quote: nearly 8,000 titles released on Steam in the first six months of 2025 had disclosed the use of generative AI, compared to around 1,000 during the entirety of 2024

claim: Steam 要求开发者承诺游戏不含违法或侵权内容，并与营销材料一致；预生成 AI 内容会像其他内容一样在发售前被审核。
source_title: Content Survey — Steamworks Documentation
quote: Under the Steam Distribution Agreement, you promise Valve that your game will not include illegal or infringing content, and that your game will be consistent with your marketing materials.

claim: 2026 年中约三分之一 Steam 新作带有 AI 披露；披露 AI 的游戏平均好评率 77%，未披露的 81%，中位数 80% 对 85%。
source_title: Tasty Chef says AI made all its art — IndieTooling（引用 Sulka Haro 对 53,597 款新作的统计）
quote: AI-disclosed games average 77% positive, against 81% for other games. The medians are 80% and 85%.

claim: 价格越高，AI 披露带来的好评率差距越大：20 美元以上为 73% 对 81%。
source_title: Tasty Chef says AI made all its art — IndieTooling（引用 Sulka Haro）
quote: The gap widens with price. At US$20 and over, it's 73% against 81%.

claim: 《Tasty Chef》全部美术与音乐由生成式 AI 制作并在商店页披露，仍获得 513 条评测 92% 好评；销量估计约 1.09 万–2.5 万份。
source_title: Tasty Chef says AI made all its art — IndieTooling
quote: Its store page says generative AI made all of its visual art and all of its music. Nearly four weeks later, Steam's own review data puts it at 92% positive from 513 reviews

claim: 《HEXSTORM》用 AI 写代码，发售后因玩家反感 AI 数小时内好评率跌到约 55%，后通过补丁与降价回升到 74%；首周约 1,200 份、毛收入约 9,500 美元。
source_title: $9,500 a week — HEXSTORM — App2top
quote: criticism from AI detractors, who in just a few hours dropped its rating to a "mixed" 55% and impacted the initial sales negatively

claim: 《How To Grow a Black Hole》未使用 AI，却被单条评测指为 “AI slop”，开发者只能公开否认；Steam 没有事后核验机制。
source_title: Steam's AI dilemma manifests in How To Grow a Black Hole — Regen Raygun
quote: I didn't use AI to make this game. The UI, code, art, and design were made by me.

claim: 一位开发者首版用 AI 做美术，首月不到 300 份（定价 20 元）；改为“零 AI”并请美术重制后，销量约 5 倍（一个月约 2,000 份）——作者自述，属个案。
source_title: 打上“零AI”，销量翻5倍 — 36氪
quote: 第一个月才卖了不到300份，一份20元 ... 游戏加了“零AI”标签之后，销量反而翻了5倍，一个月卖了2000份

claim: 第三方统计称，覆盖 2025 年 1–10 月上线的 9,879 款 Steam 游戏，披露 AI 的游戏首月评测中位数 4 条，未披露的 7 条，约少 53%。
source_title: 单人+AI，5000块做出94%好评的Steam游戏 — 什么值得买（转述 Game Oracle / AISEEBIZ）
quote: 覆盖2025年1-10月上线的9879款Steam游戏，披露使用AI开发的游戏，首月评测中位数只有4条，不用AI的是7条

source_title: 单人+AI，5000块做出94%好评的Steam游戏 — 什么值得买（转述 Game Oracle / AISEEBIZ）

claim: 美国版权局结论：完全由 AI 生成的材料不受版权保护；仅靠提示词不足以构成作者身份；人类对输出的选择、编排、修改可以形成可保护的表达。
source_title: Copyright and Artificial Intelligence, Part 2: Copyrightability — U.S. Copyright Office
quote: prompts do not alone provide sufficient control ... Copyright does not extend to purely AI-generated material, or material where there is insufficient human control over the expressive elements.
note: 来源为 PDF，curl 未做正文比对；本轮已通过检索返回的全文片段核对引文。

claim: D.C. 巡回上诉法院 2025 年 3 月维持了版权局对纯 AI 生成图片登记的拒绝，确认人类作者要求。
source_title: United States Copyright Office Annual Report FY 2025 — U.S. Copyright Office
quote: In Thaler v. Perlmutter, the D.C. Circuit in March 2025 unanimously upheld our refusal and affirmed the human authorship requirement in the case of an image created wholly by generative AI.
note: 来源为 PDF，curl 未做正文比对；本轮已通过检索返回的全文片段核对引文。

source_title: Using Images & Videos Commercially — Midjourney

claim: 欧盟 AI Act 第 50 条自 2026-08-02 适用；第 50(2) 的机器可读标记义务落在生成式 AI 系统的提供者（如 Midjourney、Adobe），不是使用其输出的游戏开发者。
source_title: Transparency obligations under Article 50 of the AI Act — European Commission
quote: According to Article 50(2) of the AI Act, providers of AI systems ... generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content, must ensure that AI-generated or manipulated content are marked ... Article 50 of the AI Act applies as from 2 August 2026.

claim: 欧盟委员会 2026 年 7 月指引：仅在游戏等生产流程闭环中使用、且不是 AI 系统最终输出的内容，不在第 50(2) 标记范围内；只有工作流的最终输出需要标记。
source_title: Guidelines on the implementation of the transparency obligations under Article 50 — European Commission (C(2026) 5054)
quote: Outputs that are only used in closed loop environments in industrial and product development workflows (for example for film, animation, games or advertising production), unless they are the final output of the AI system
note: 来源为 PDF，curl 未做正文比对；本轮已通过检索返回的全文片段核对引文。

claim: 第 50(4) 对深度伪造的披露义务，在内容属于明显的艺术、创作、讽刺、虚构作品时，限于以不干扰作品展示与享受的方式披露“存在 AI 生成内容”。
source_title: Article 50: Transparency obligations — AI Act Service Desk
quote: Where the content forms part of an evidently artistic, creative, satirical, fictional or analogous work or programme, the transparency obligations set out in this paragraph are limited to disclosure of the existence of such generated or manipulated content in an appropriate manner that does not hamper the display or enjoyment of the work.

claim: 面向游戏的 AI 精灵管线已能生成多方向、多动作的精灵表，并显式处理共享单元格、枢轴与循环连续性——这反过来说明原始生成结果本身并不天然是引擎可用资产。
source_title: AI Sprite Sheet Generator for 2D Games — SpriteCanvas
quote: Every frame is checked for size, foot contact and loop continuity before you adopt it, and the export carries the cell size, pivot and per-frame timing your engine needs.
